outcome: successful TOLAC (Vaginal Birth After Cesarean - VBAC)
cohort: Sixty pregnant women with a history of one previous lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) were enrolled.
finding: Among women with one previous LSCS attempting TOLAC, 78.33% achieved a successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
mod_finding: Successful TOLAC was significantly associated with cervical dilatation of 4 cm or more at admission and a history of previous vaginal birth, while birth weight over 3,000 gm was associated with a lower success rate.
